buffer_swirl.owner_comment: Its decent but the spec IMO could use a little more pattern work (make it come through more)

Strong M-channel gradient between hot/cool zones.

crackle_network.owner_comment: Dinging it because of similarities with other finishes

spec_iridescent_film.owner_comment: Another one where the preview looks much better than the rendering result. They look like different finishes
